description: [Migawari] Read the status and the operator's answer for a free-text need submitted via request_anything. Statuses: received (not yet answered), answered (read operator_messages), converted (a priced quote was created in the normal flow — see quote_id), closed. The access_token returned by request_anything is required.
name: migawari__get_need_status
title: Get the operator's answer to a free-text need
